title: Decode: MegaMoE NVFP4 EP32 + shared-expert overlap
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows), SP shard = 96 MoE tokens per GPU, 28 local experts, top-16, L~135K, k=3
basis: baseline: coordinator seed (gap512 EP16 B92 moved to EP32). achievable: model rows at EP32 T=96 tokens/GPU: MegaMoE 37.0 us/layer (ops + P11/P12; moe_ep32 t_ach interp T64/T128) x 92 = 3.40 ms + shared experts MXFP8 0.95 ms (optables nvfp4 D3-32 r8/r32 interp) = 4.35 ms. Measured FI a368c5f66 1-GPU (28 experts, no comm) T96 = 48.9 us/layer.
gap_analysis: MEASURED 1-GPU EP32-shape emulation (FI a368c5f66, 28 local experts, random top-16, NVFP4, CUDA graph x10, no NVLink): per layer 34.7 / 43.7 / 45.1 / 48.9 / 52.3 us at T 1/4/32/96/128. Per call at T96: main persistent kernel 43.7 us, router kernel 3.5, separate BF16 top-k reduce 2.7, NVFP4 quant+stage 1.9 (partly PDL-overlapped). Hecate EP32 (same kernel, 32 GPUs) adds ~17 us of dispatch/combine at T64-T128 (62.8/69.1 us). The weight stream itself is not the limit: going from ~13 active experts (T1) to 28 (T96) adds ~13 us for ~2x the bytes, i.e. the marginal stream runs near the die-local HBM rate, while ~18-20 us per call is fixed overhead inside the main kernel even with no comm (startup, sizes-ready wait, FC1->FC2 per-expert dependency tail, combine/finalize), plus ~5-8 us in the 3 side kernels. So the gap to the model (37 us/layer incl. comm) = fixed in-kernel latency (~18 us) + comm latency not overlapped with the weight stream (~17 us) + side kernels. In-kernel stamps (T96, 1 GPU): front ~3 us (quant/stage + router before weights stream), stream ~34 us, tail ~5-6 us (CTA end imbalance ~4 us + barrier ~1.2 us), separate reduce ~3 us. No ncu/nsys in the image: diagnostics use globaltimer stamps on the kernel iket ranges.
inefficiencies: MEASURED (stamps, 1 GPU T96): weights stream only after the router publishes sizes (~3 us after the call starts); at T>=4 every local expert is active so the weight stream does not depend on routing
MEASURED: CTA finish imbalance ~4 us at the end of the stream (median vs max last-MMA end), then a ~1.2 us tail barrier
MEASURED: separate BF16 top-k reduce kernel ~2.7 us and NVFP4 quant/stage kernel ~1.9 us per call around the persistent kernel
MEASURED (Hecate EP32 vs 1 GPU): ~17 us/call of dispatch/combine latency not hidden behind the weight stream at EP32
MEASURED: stream phase itself ~85-90% of the die-local HBM rate (weights die-localized + die_split active)
In-tree D3-32 runs vendored DeepGEMM fp8_fp4 (no NVFP4 EP32 backend); shared experts serial on that path (fix: megamoe_rubin re-vendor, landed on the branch)
